notes.title: Small performance improvements (1.0.1)
notes.notes:
[b]Added settings![/b]
You can select max FPS in-game, disable background animation and falling apples on background. Also you can reset game or case progress in case of problems (doesn't allow to receive one-time cases multiple times).

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Performance improvements.
Fixed edge case, where your selected skin apple might reset to default apple.

[b]Linux:[/b]
Fix running game on older GLIBC

notes.title: Game is released!
notes.notes: You can access game right now!

notes.title: Release date - Today!
notes.notes:
With slight delay game will be released 5 July 2024 at 18:00 UTC. There will be first week case, claimable once per day, make sure to get it. From it you can get a unique apple of the first week, which can be used as a skin!

Don't forget to join our Discord server for communication: https://discord.gg/ymxYHDSF
